info.title: Capital Franchise Supply Chain Management System API Document

get.description: Receive Instant Payment Notification (IPN) callbacks from VNPay. Acts as a dispatcher to classify the transaction type (e.g., Customer Orders vs. Supplier Purchase Orders) and securely route the payload to the appropriate underlying Microservice via gRPC.

200.description: Always returns HTTP 200 with VNPay standard RspCode and Message

BearerAuth.description: Don't forget to type "Bearer" before the token. For example: Bearer eyJhbG...
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
